text: Proposal for the Merge queue for CI work: adopt a merge queue for ci. Pull requests sit for days and main breaks twice a week.
Worried about a slow queue blocks everyone. Can we roll it out to a few accounts first?
Fine by me as long as we can turn it off quickly.
Chiming in from the next team over: this affects us too, please keep us posted.
Did we consider the other option, 'Quarantine flaky tests'?
Going ahead. Decision record to follow.
